name: JERSEY CARAMEL
description: Old school classic that offers a smooth caramel flavour. Bringing back all your favourite childhood memories, this treat delivers the timeless taste of creamy caramel in every bite. Snack on nostalgia at any time, anywhere.
longDescription: Sugar, glucose syrup, sweetened condensed milk (milk, sugar), vegetable oil, wheat flour, tapioca starch, gelatine, caramel (150a), salt, flavour, emulsifier (soy lecithin, 322)

name: GLO HEARTS (MAYCEYS)
description: Glo Hearts are delightful aniseed-flavoured red jelly hearts that are a favourite among Kiwis. Their unique flavour and chewy texture make them a popular treat for all ages.
longDescription:
Ingredients
Glucose syrup, sugar, gelatine, water, acid, modified maize starch (1401), flavours, colour (123)

Flavours
Aniseed
